Purpose and culture

For 175 years, Smiths has pushed the boundaries of engineering capability, driven by our powerful culture founded on our values, innovation and excellence.

Engineering a better future

From our origins in precision timekeeping to the advanced components supporting the historic Artemis II moon mission, Smiths products have shaped the future of transport, energy, industrial processes and other human endeavour. Engineering a better future unites our people, shapes the way we think and act, and drives us to create lasting value and sustain growth in the future.

Our culture inspires and empowers our people to continually seek new ideas and execute them with passion and commitment.

Our values

Our values are the things that are most important to us as an organisation. They make us reliable, trustworthy and valued partners, and they make Smiths a great place to work. We live our values every day, in each action and decision that we take.

Talent

We are investing to build the skills and capabilities that will power future growth. We are backing our people and prioritising the skills and leadership qualities that matter most to future performance. We have created skills road maps aligned with our technical roadmaps to identify the skills we need to build on, and we have early careers and apprenticeship programmes that are helping us attract and develop the next generation of talent.

Building a culture where everyone thrives

In today’s evolving workplace there is one constant: people. At Smiths we believe that people are at the heart of a successful organisation. Fostering a deep sense of belonging in our people is not just a cultural aspiration but a strategic imperative.

Find out more

Code of Business Ethics

The Smiths Code outlines the standards of behaviour to which we all commit. It is a practical guide to what ‘doing the right thing’ looks like when conducting business and relationships legally, ethically and with integrity.

Find out more

Smiths Excellence

Smiths Excellence is how we solve problems and deliver results at Smiths. It is based on lean six sigma principles that drive operational excellence in support of our strategy. It empowers every colleague to challenge the status quo, become an innovator and solve problems at their root cause to unlock value. Across the entire organisation, Smiths Excellence is at the centre of how we work, blending tested approaches with practical learning and development to make us faster to market, more efficient and more sustainable.
